alerts.title: 📰 Carnell Tate
alerts.body: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Tate (shoulder) will practice Wednesday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.co…

report.what: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said that Tate (shoulder) will practice Wednesday, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.. Tate has been sidelined for the Titans' past two games and wasn't able to practice in advance of either contest while he managed the shoulder injury, but he'll take a notable step forward in his recovery by getting back on the field. While the Titans won't reveal until after practice concludes whether Tate was a full or limited participant, the rookie's involvement in the team's first Week 11 session is generally a positive sign for his chances of playing Sunday in Dallas.
report.means: Questionable this week. Chance to play: Wk 11 70%, Wk 12 95%, Wk 13 95%, Wk 14 95%, Wk 15 95%, Wk 16 95%, Wk 17 95%.

alerts.title: 📰 Geno Smith
alerts.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Smith (ankle) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Br…

report.what: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Smith (ankle) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.. Smith was unable to return to this past Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills after tweaking his left ankle in the third quarter, but medical tests conducted after the game revealed no major injury. The veteran signal-caller will still be operating with a cap on his reps to begin Week 11 prep, and Glenn acknowledged that the Jets will wait and see how Smith fares as the week rolls along before a decision is made on his status for Sunday's game against the Chargers. Rookie Cade Klubnik would be in line to start in Los Angeles if Smith isn't cleare
report.means: Questionable this week. Chance to play: Wk 11 70%, Wk 12 95%, Wk 13 95%, Wk 14 95%, Wk 15 95%, Wk 16 95%, Wk 17 95%.

alerts.title: 🚨 TEST: Bowers questionable to return (ankle)
alerts.body: Went to the locker room in the 2nd quarter. Starting in Od from oxtail.

report.what: TEST (this didn't really happen). Brock Bowers went to the locker room late in the 2nd quarter vs Denver after a defender rolled up on his right ankle on a short catch. The Raiders list him questionable to return. He had 4 catches for 52 yards (11.2 fantasy pts) before he left.
report.means: If he doesn't come back you're stuck with his 11.2 for this game. The bigger question is the playoffs: ankle injuries like this usually show up on the next week's practice report, so until we see practice we'd drop him to about 60% for next week. Your title odds would go from 28.8% to roughly 25.9% if he misses time.
report.todo: Nothing to do for this game, since lineups lock once it starts. For next week you don't roster a backup TE, so watch his Wednesday practice. If he's limited or out, the best TE on waivers is Chig Okonkwo (9.9 a game) or Darren Waller (9.5 a game). You'll get another alert the moment his status changes.
